description: Image Description: A black bird, likely a cormorant, is perched on a bare, leafless tree branch that extends over a calm body of water. The bird has its wings fully spread out, possibly to dry them after swimming or diving. Its feathers are dark and sleek, and it appears to be facing slightly to the right.
